reviews.text: Shirley did a great job with my hair! I recently moved from out-of-state, and my hair is definitely not used to the water here. I came in with brassy hair, and Shirley fixed it with good product and styling. I love the cut as well!
Mira is amazing. She really listens and gives you the best outcome. She goes above and beyond to make sure you leave happy and looking your best. I cannot recommend her enough.
Had a wonderful facial with Sunny! The facial was very relaxing and lovely experience. My skin feels soft and smooth. The space was lovely and well maintained. Great experience!
